title: Stonetalon Mountains
body: The Stonetalon Mountains rise west of the Barrens and south of Ashenvale, a range of forested peaks, deep canyons and mountain lakes, and both tauren and night elves have long held its great peak sacred. In the Third War, Jaina Proudmoore and Thrall each came to the caverns of Stonetalon Peak seeking the Oracle, and there the prophet Medivh urged orc and human to set aside old hatreds and stand together against the Burning Legion. Today the mountains are wounded. The Venture Company is stripping Windshear Crag of its forests, and the fires of its machines left the Charred Vale a blackened ruin of raging elementals and Bloodfury harpies. The spirits of the land cry out in pain, and both the Horde and the night elves have heard them. The Horde holds Sun Rock Retreat and the troll camp of Malaka'jin, while the night elves keep a small outpost on Stonetalon Peak beside the barrow of the Talon Den. Grimtotem tauren prowl the southeastern valleys, spiders haunt the Webwinder Path, and kobolds dig deep beneath Boulderslide Ravine.

title: Greatwood Vale
body: The Greatwood Vale lies in the southeast of the mountains, where the road running west from the Crossroads climbs out of the Barrens. The Horde shaman Seereth Stonebreak keeps her camp near its edge, at the border of the two lands, and from there the way leads on to the northwest toward the logging grounds of Windshear Crag. The vale is not safe. Grimtotem mercenaries and ruffians roam its woods in great numbers, with brutes and sorcerers among them. Close to the troll camp of Malaka'jin, night elves sit caged in the vale as prisoners of the witch doctor Jin'Zil.

title: Malaka'jin
body: Malaka'jin is a small troll camp at the base of the mountains, in the far southeast near the Barrens. Its people live well off the hunting in these hills, though lately spiders have been creeping into the camp by night to steal their kills, and Xen'Zilla wants the beasts thinned. In his cave at the camp, the witch doctor Jin'Zil keeps caged night elves and bubbling cauldrons of his own brews. Ken'zigla prepares healing draughts for wounded Horde soldiers as far off as Camp Taurajo, and Darn Talongrip sends willing recruits north to join the Horde campaign in Ashenvale.

title: Camp Aparaje
body: Camp Aparaje was a small tauren village in the southeastern hills of Stonetalon, home to Makaba Flathoof and his daughter Kaya. The Grimtotem fell upon it, led by Grundig Darkcloud of the post further up the path, and killed nearly everyone. Makaba slew all the raiders he could before he barely escaped with his life, and he now waits on the edge of the mountains by the Barrens, sure his daughter was lost in the attack. Grimtotem ruffians and mercenaries still pick through the abandoned camp. For those who know these trails, though, Aparaje remains a landmark on the road home.

title: Grimtotem Post
body: Grimtotem Post is a camp of the Grimtotem tribe in the southeastern Stonetalon Mountains, a little further up the path beyond Camp Aparaje. Brutes stand guard and sorcerers work their magic here, and none of them welcomes outsiders. The post is commanded by Grundig Darkcloud, who led the brutal raid that destroyed Aparaje, and his own band of brutes stays close about him. A tauren called Gorehoof the Black roams the camp as well.

title: The Webwinder Path
body: The Webwinder Path is the long road that winds north from the southern valleys through the heart of the mountains, toward Sun Rock Retreat and Windshear Crag. It is named well. Deepmoss spiders, creepers and venomspitters, hunt along its length, and travelers who walk it by night risk the fangs of Besseleth, the great spider of nearby Sishir Canyon, whose bounty notice is posted beside the road. On a rise overlooking the valley that leads into Windshear Crag, the night elf Kaela Shadowspear and her gnome companion Gaxim Rustfizzle have made their camp, plotting against the Venture Company.

title: Sishir Canyon
body: Sishir Canyon opens west of the Webwinder Path, and it belongs to the spiders. Besseleth and her eight-legged brood have claimed it as their webbed lair, and the canyon floor is thick with deepmoss creepers, webspinners and venomspitters among clusters of eggs. Besseleth is an old predator of these parts who hunts the road by night, and she once caught Maggran Earthbinder of Sun Rock Retreat with her two-foot fang. A goblin trader in Ratchet pays well for deepmoss eggs, now prized for omelettes in Booty Bay, though even he warns that gathering them in Sishir is not for the weak of stomach.

title: Boulderslide Ravine
body: Southeast of Sun Rock Retreat, Boulderslide Ravine cuts into the mountains, and at its end a deep cavern runs far beneath the stone. The Gogger kobolds have claimed it, rock keepers, geomancers and stonepounders who mine a rare crystal called resonite with frantic haste and shriek at anyone who reaches for their candles. What drives them to dig so deep is unknown, but the shaman Mor'rogal of Sun Rock senses something evil lurking beneath these mountains.

title: Sun Rock Retreat
body: Sun Rock Retreat is the Horde's stronghold in the Stonetalon Mountains, a village of tauren and orcs tucked among the peaks south of Mirkfallon Lake and guarded by Stonetalon grunts. Its leader, the veteran Maggran Earthbinder, was sent here by Cairne Bloodhoof himself. Tammra Windfield calls on the Earthmother to help the scorched land grow again, the shaman Mor'rogal senses something evil stirring beneath the mountains, and Tsunaman serves the Tribunal of the Tides, waging the ancient war of water against fire in the Charred Vale. An inn and a wind rider post serve travelers, and at the edge of the village the mage Braelyn Firehand pursues a darker purpose of her own.

title: Mirkfallon Lake
body: Mirkfallon Lake lies north of Sun Rock Retreat, its shores the home of the Pridewing wyverns. Consorts, skyhunters and soarers nest about the water, a great patriarch among them, and a wyvern called Sorrow Wing hunts the shore. Sources in Theramore claim the orcs gather pridewing venom here for their assassins, and the Sentinels of Astranaar have sent fighters south to deny them the source. The lake also holds gentler gifts. Gaea seeds, found nowhere else in the mountains, lie along the water's edge, and the tauren of Sun Rock gather them in the hope of restoring Stonetalon's lost forests.

title: The Charred Vale
body: The Charred Vale in the southwest of the mountains was once a verdant forest. The Venture Company set it ablaze and turned its machines of destruction upon it, and in doing so loosed raging spirits of flame and stone. The treants of the vale seem to have driven the goblins back, but even these guardians were corrupted, some perhaps by the weapons the goblins used in their retreat, and blackened ancients now lumber through the ash. The Bloodfury harpies have since made the vale their stronghold, barring the druids who would heal it, while scorched basilisks and chimaeras hunt the burned slopes. The road south to Desolace runs through it.

title: Windshear Crag
body: Windshear Crag is a broad valley in the east of the mountains, and it is where the Venture Company's greed is laid bare. Loggers, deforesters and operators swarm a landscape of stumps and fouled water, and the company's lumber mill stands south of Cragpool Lake. Two great shredders marked XT:4 and XT:9 fell trees faster than the spirits can bear, and wagons of explosives wait along the trails. Kobold diggers toil for the company here too, and deepmoss spiders lay their eggs under what trees remain. On the crag's western edge, the goblin Ziz Fizziks, fired when a gnome took charge of the operation, has set up camp and now works against his former employers.

title: Windshear Mine
body: The Windshear Mine sits at the far eastern end of Windshear Crag, where the Blackwolf River ends. The Venture Company works it with kobolds in its employ, diggers, geomancers and overlords, and on Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle's orders large amounts of a strange gold-green ore are being hauled from its depths, for a purpose none of the miners has learned. Among them toils Piznik, once the second most important goblin at the site, sent down to the tunnels when Gerenzo took over. The company keeps some of its letters here, deep inside.

title: Cragpool Lake
body: Cragpool Lake lies in the north of Windshear Crag, and the Venture Company has crowded its shores. Oil spills slick the water, while engineers, machine smiths and builders keep the company's machines running along the banks, and a goblin named Nizzik sells Venture armor to any customer with coin. Far above the lake, up beside the great water wheel, Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle keeps watch over the entire site from his high platform. From the lake the Blackwolf River runs out through the crag, and travelers bound for Stonetalon Peak skirt the water before turning north up the steep slopes.

title: Blackwolf River
body: The Blackwolf River runs out of Cragpool Lake and down through Windshear Crag to the mine at its far end, and its waters have been fouled by the Venture Company's logging of the valley. The company's crews have stripped the banks bare. Loggers, deforesters and operators work the riverside, kobold geomancers among them, oil leaks into the current, and a wagon of explosives waits nearby. Two hard bosses drive the work here: Foreman Rigger, a human, and Taskmaster Whipfang, a gnoll.

title: The Talondeep Path
body: The Talondeep Path is a long tunnel bored through the mountains, joining Windshear Crag to southern Ashenvale not far from Mystral Lake. It is a main road between Stonetalon and the forest: night elves bound for Stonetalon Peak travel it, and Horde caravans running between the mountains and Splintertree Post depend on it, so that trouble at Mystral Lake can bring them to a standstill. Deepmoss spiders lurk in its shadows and lay their eggs in the dark. Near its Stonetalon mouth waits a tauren named Braug Dimspirit.

title: Stonetalon Peak
body: Stonetalon Peak crowns the far northwest of the mountains, a high forested valley that local peoples have long held sacred. Ruins of an ancient temple of Queen Azshara still stand here. The night elves keep a small outpost here with an inn and a hippogryph roost, where Keeper Albagorm watches over the land, and the Sons and Daughters of Cenarius and their botanists tend the woods, while sap beasts, twilight runners and fey dragons roam among the trees. In the Third War, Jaina Proudmoore's expedition camped by the caverns of the peak, and Thrall came there too in search of the Oracle.

title: The Talon Den
body: The Talon Den is a barrow den built by the druids on Stonetalon Peak. Cenarion druids and caretakers walk its halls beside the Mirkfallon dryads, and an ancient keeper of the grove, Gatekeeper Kordurus, stands among them. Caches of the druids stand here and there about the den, and the dryad Rynthariel bears the title of its Keymaster. A night elf called Brother Ravenoak prowls its depths, and somewhere deeper within lies a hoard the druids guard closely.

title: Seereth Stonebreak
body: Seereth Stonebreak is a promising shaman of the Horde, sent to Stonetalon when the land cried out. She camps where the road from the Crossroads meets the mountains, near the Greatwood Vale, and to her the spirit of Stonetalon weeps from its peaks, its rivers and its severed, dying trees. Shamans can hear the pleas of such spirits because their magic is kin to the natural magic of the druids, she says, though many of the whispers are lost to her. She asks for help against the Venture Company, in the one language the goblins understand best: violence.

title: Maggran Earthbinder
body: Maggran Earthbinder leads Sun Rock Retreat, an old tauren warrior who admits that age and countless battles have hardened his skin and his soul. He believes that is why Cairne Bloodhoof gave him this post, where gentle winds and warm sun ease his pain. Maggran takes the tauren duty as protectors of the land seriously. He holds the Bloodfury harpies of the Charred Vale to be the source of the harpies spreading across Kalimdor and wants their queen, Bloodfury Ripper, dead, and he has put a bounty on the spider Besseleth, whose fang once wounded him.

title: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil
body: Jin'Zil is a troll witch doctor who lives in a cave at Malaka'jin, among bubbling cauldrons, and he greets visitors with the cry that the spirits are restless. His temper is gleeful and cruel. Three night elves sit caged near his camp, and for these tree-hugging friends, as he calls them, he means to brew what he calls forest magic, out of sap from Stonetalon Peak, the whiskers of twilight runners, a fey dragon's scale and as many courser eyes as he can get. One can never have enough eyes, he says.

title: Braelyn Firehand
body: Braelyn Firehand is a mage who camps at Sun Rock Retreat, and she despises these mountains. The druids of Stonetalon Peak and the kin of Cenarius stifle the flow of magic far beyond their forests, and here, she says, channeling a spell is like drawing water from a well with a bucket full of holes. She longs to return to Jaedenar and exult in the flow of magic there, but her master will not let her go until her work is done, and she seeks out those who love the night elves as little as she does.

When the forest spirits whisper to Faldreas Goeth'Shael in Astranaar, it is to Albagorm that the brave are sent, through the Talondeep Path and up the steep slopes past Cragpool Lake. His great hope is the Charred Vale. He means to restore it to the lush forest it once was, but first the Bloodfury harpies who bar the druids from the vale must be driven out.

From her camp above the road into Windshear Crag she has spent most of her days fighting the Venture Company's destruction. That a night elf and a gnome must work together shows how grave things are, she admits, but she asks others not to judge Gaxim too quickly. She still misses her homeland and her friend Tara Thenysil in Astranaar, and the first time she saw the Charred Vale, she nearly wept.

The goblin was so appalled that he begged Sputtervalve of the Tinkers' Union in Ratchet for a new job, and when Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle took over the site, Ziz was thrown out. Now he camps on the crag's western edge, eager to prove his loyalty to his new boss, though he admits a goblin's honor is only worth so much, and that Sputtervalve is the cruelest slave driver he has ever met. Gerenzo, he says, wants him dead on sight.

He sent help west from the Crossroads to the promising shaman Seereth Stonebreak, who had reported deforestation on a massive scale. She asks first for the answer the goblins understand best: violence, carried northwest beyond the Greatwood Vale to the Venture Company's crews in Windshear Crag.

title: Cenarius' Legacy
body: Braelyn Firehand came to Stonetalon at the bidding of her master in Jaedenar, and she hates the land with all her heart. The kin of Cenarius and the kaldorei druids at the peak use their powers to stifle the flow of magic, even this far south of their beloved forests, and she will not be allowed home until her work is done. She asks for help from those who love the night elves as little as she does. First, the flow of magic must be restored, and for that the Sons and Daughters of Cenarius and their botanists on the peak must die.
sources: quest 1087 description and reward text (master in Jaedenar; kill Sons and Daughters of Cenarius and botanists; power so sweet, the rushing flood)

parts.body: When the druids' people had fallen, Braelyn felt power flood back into her veins, sweet and rushing. The kaldorei, she said, are fools to spurn such gifts, and life without the burning embrace of magic is a pale mockery.
sources: quest 1087 reward text

parts.body: Her magic then granted her true sight, and she found what the druids had tried to hide: Keeper Ordanus, spirited away from the peak before she could find him, now concealed far off in Ashenvale. She wanted his head.
sources: quest 1088 description (true sight; Raynewood; spirited away from the peak before I could find him; I will have his head)
ashenvale.json Raynewood Retreat entry (Ordanus hiding at the top of the tree)

parts.body: When his head was brought to her, Braelyn told more of her errand. Her master had sent her to the peak expecting her only to slaughter the night elves crawling over the ruined temple of Azshara, which she called her own people's, but Ordanus had slipped her grasp. She had known him long ago, and gloated that the arrogant keeper's head did not rise so high now.
sources: quest 1088 request and reward text

parts.body: Last, she revealed a secret wrung from one of the druids: a key hidden in a small lantern at the entrance of the Talon Den unlocks the druids' caches, and through them the hoard within.
sources: quest 1089 description (extract some details from one of them; Gatekeeper's Key in a lantern; caches; hoard)

title: On Guard in Stonetalon
body: Stonetalon is a land plagued by the Venture Company and other enemies of the night elves, and Sentinel Raene Wolfrunner sent Kaela Shadowspear there to learn what was happening to it. Kaela's friend, Sentinel Tara Thenysil of Astranaar, has heard nothing from her since, and the news that the Alliance sent a gnome mage along only deepens her worry: to her it is a sure sign of trouble. She asks a traveler bound for the mountains to find Kaela and bring back word.
sources: quest 1070 description (Thenysil, Kaela, gnome mage)
quest 1085 description
quest 1071 description and reward text

parts.body: Kaela was alive, camped above the road into Windshear Crag, and she had spent most of her time fighting the Venture Company's destruction. That a night elf and a gnome must work together showed how grave things were, she admitted, but her companion Gaxim Rustfizzle understood the need, and any help had to begin with him.

quest 1085 description

parts.body: It began with explosions. Goblin crews were driven back while Gaxim gathered his materials: volatile Nitromirglyceronium from an old colleague in Tinker Town, made from potions brought to his door, and a scroll of messaging from Collin Mauren in Stormwind, crafted with debris from a Westfall dust devil, so that the charges could be fired from afar, with wagons of dynamite as the distraction.

In the plans Gaxim saw weaknesses to exploit and designs to borrow, and he sent the letters on to Kaela, sure that she and the Sentinels would want to see them.

quest 1091 description (take these letters to Kaela; she or the Sentinels will want to know)

parts.body: Kaela sent word home to Astranaar: she and Gaxim were alive and well on their way to stopping the Venture Company and healing the land. Thenysil was glad to hear it, of Kaela and even of Gaxim, and she believed the mission might strengthen the night elves' foothold in Stonetalon. She sent the messenger on to Darnassus, where Tyrande Whisperwind herself would wish to give thanks.
sources: quest 1082 description and reward text
quest 1081 description (offered on turning in 1082)

title: Reclaiming the Charred Vale
body: In Astranaar, Faldreas Goeth'Shael listens to the spirits of the forest, and they told him of one brave enough to travel. He sends that traveler south through the Talondeep Path, across the ravaged Windshear Crag and up the steep slopes to Stonetalon Peak, where Keeper Albagorm waits. The keeper's grief is for the Charred Vale, once forest, now ash, set afire by a greedy mechanized army of industrialists. The druids wish to begin its regrowth, but the Bloodfury harpies who have settled the burned vale will not let them pass, and Albagorm wants them driven out.
sources: quest 1056 description and reward text (forest spirits tell me you are brave; route; Faldreas has listened to the forest spirits)
quest 1057 description, request and reward text (set afire by the greedy mechanized army of industrialists; Bloodfuries refuse passage; restore the lush forest)

Nothing more is claimed of the vale's fate. Earlier: verified. 1056 is a breadcrumb for 1057. 1059 ends with Falfindel in Feralas (area 489 Thalanaar) but has no follow-up; nothing more is claimed.

parts.body: Harpies, ambushers, slayers and roguefeathers fell until the flock had suffered a great loss. Albagorm knew they would regroup soon, and so he sent word far south, past the Barrens and through Thousand Needles, to the druid Falfindel Waywarder at the edge of Feralas, who has the power to call great forest spirits to help in the vale's reclamation.
sources: quest 1057 reward text
quest 1059 description (offered on turning in 1057)

parts.body: Falfindel judged the keeper wise to send word with such urgency, and he means to call forth aid from the great forest, to travel to the Charred Vale before it is too late.
sources: quest 1059 reward text

title: The Seeds of Gaea
body: At Sun Rock Retreat, Tammra Windfield grieves for a land wrecked by industrial greed and endless war, and she holds that only the blessings of the Earthmother can cure such an injury. Her hope lies in the Gaea seed, found nowhere else but along the shores of Mirkfallon Lake, north of the retreat near the water's edge. She means to imbue the seeds with shamanic power to speed their growth, so that the cycle of rebirth may begin to replenish the land.
sources: quest 6301 description and reward text (industrial greed and continuous war; blessings of the Earthmother; Gaea seeds only found at Mirkfallon Lake; imbue with shamanistic power; Tammra begins to chant)

quest 6381 description, request and reward text (plant at the center of the destruction in the Charred Vale; harpies and fire elementals; resist corruption, foothold for other life; Venture Co. will pack up, fire spirits calm, harpies pushed out; then truly at peace)
zone_areas: Gaea Seed 177926 at Mirkfallon Lake, Gaea Dirt Mound 177929 in the Charred Vale
notes: Checked: 6301 has no RewardNextQuest, so 6381's line (the land is in pain, the cycle of life is powerful) moved from part 1 to part 2, which is unlocked on turning in 6381; part 1 now rests on 6301 alone. Converted: the opening is the 6301 premise; Tammra's blessing moved to part 1 (turn-in of 6301), the planting and her hopes to part 2 (turn-in of 6381). Earlier: verified. Tammra is also Kaya's aunt (quest 6401), told in the Camp Aparaje story.

parts.body: Once the seeds were gathered, Tammra began to chant over them, imbuing them with shamanic power and calling on the blessing of the Earthmother, so that even such small kernels of life might bloom and flourish.
sources: quest 6301 description and reward text (I will imbue them with shamanistic power; the blessing of the Earthmother; Tammra begins to chant)

parts.body: The land is in pain, Tammra says, but the cycle of life is a powerful thing. The enchanted seeds were carried west into the heart of the destruction, the Charred Vale, past harpies and raging fire spirits, and planted in mounds of fertile soil. Such seeds resist corruption and will make a foothold for other life. In time the Venture Company will pack up its saws, the fire spirits will calm, the harpies will be pushed out by the land itself, and only then will Stonetalon truly know peace.
sources: quest 6381 description, request and reward text
zone_areas: Gaea Dirt Mound 177929 in the Charred Vale

title: Gerenzo's Orders
body: When the Venture Company hired the gnome Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle to run its Windshear Crag outfit, the goblin engineer Ziz Fizziks was so appalled that he begged Sputtervalve of the Tinkers' Union in Ratchet for a new job, and he was soon thrown out of the company. Sputtervalve, who says the Venture Company stole many of the best goblin minds, is glad of a chance to steal some back. He set Ziz to work from a camp on the crag's western edge, where the goblin is eager to learn what Gerenzo is planning and to prove his loyalty to his new boss.

title: The Fall of Camp Aparaje
body: Makaba Flathoof waits at the edge of the mountains by the Barrens, one of the very few who lived through the day the Grimtotem came to Camp Aparaje. The raiders killed most everyone in the village. Makaba killed all he could before he fled with his life, and he will never forget what the Grimtotem did there. Now he asks only that more of them die, starting with the ruffians and mercenaries who prowl the woods just to the west. Among the dead, he believes, was his own daughter Kaya.
sources: quest 6548 description and reward text (Grimtotem raided my village, killed most everyone, I killed all I could, barely escaped; just to the west)
quest 6629 description (Grundig Darkcloud and his personal band of brutes, led the attack, Grimtotem Post)
quest 6523 description (thank you for rescuing me, escort me to Camp Aparaje, from there I know my way, father Makaba)

parts.body: Inside the post waited something Makaba never expected. His daughter Kaya, believed lost in the attack, was alive and a prisoner. Freed, she begged to be taken back to Camp Aparaje before her captors noticed she was gone, for from there she knew the way home, and her father would be desperate to know she was safe.
sources: quest 6523 description

parts.body: Grimtotem brutes, ruffians and sorcerers struck again along the way, but Kaya reached the ruins of her village and set off home from there. Makaba rejoiced: Kaya was alive. He sent the good news on to Sun Rock Retreat, to her aunt, Tammra Windfield.
sources: creature_text 11856 and npc_kaya_flathoof (ambush by Ruffian, Brute, Sorcerer; I know my way back from here)
quest 6523 reward text (Kaya is alive)
quest 6401 description (offered on turning in 6523)

title: Earthen Arise
body: The shaman Mor'rogal of Sun Rock Retreat can feel a tension in the air of Stonetalon, a sense that something evil lurks beneath the mountains. Southeast of the retreat, in a deep cave in Boulderslide Ravine, the Gogger kobolds are mining a rare crystal called resonite in a frenzy, and Mor'rogal wants samples of the ore and word of what lies at the bottom of the cave. He half remembers some legend tied to resonite but cannot place it, and he hopes the depths will reveal what the kobolds intend.
sources: quest 6421 description, request and reward text (tension, evil under the mountains, southeast cave, kobolds frantically mining Resonite, legend; trace of Earthen magic, created by the Titans to create the land, enchant the samples)
quest 6481 description, request and reward text (Resonite cask houses slumbering Earthen Goggeroc; enchanted crystal to smash it; weak from slumber; what an Earthen would mean to Kalimdor)

Goggeroc 11920 is summoned from the cask, so no KILL trigger. Earlier: 'before he could fully wake' softened to his weakness after slumber (6481). Goggeroc 11920 is summoned from the cask (no fixed spawn), so no KILL trigger.

parts.body: The crystals confirmed the legend: they bore a trace of earthen magic. The kobolds must have dug deep enough to uncover an earthen, and the earthen were made by the titans to shape the very land. Mor'rogal shook his head at the threat and set about enchanting the samples to use against the kobolds' plot.
sources: quest 6421 request and reward text

parts.body: The resonite cask at the bottom of the cave houses a slumbering earthen named Goggeroc. Mor'rogal enchanted a crystal to smash the cask open, knowing the earthen would wake weak from his long slumber, and that weakness was the one chance to slay him.
sources: quest 6481 description and request text

parts.body: Goggeroc was slain while that weakness lasted. Mor'rogal feared what such a being might have meant for all of Kalimdor, and he counted Stonetalon and Kalimdor alike in debt to the one who struck him down.
sources: quest 6481 reward text
